verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers strong programmatic building blocks — the Airbyte API for scripted pipeline creation/control, Terraform provider for config-as-code, abctl CLI for headless deployment, and PyAirbyte for Python/AI developers to extract and load data without a server — plus MCP servers letting agents query/act on data. However, no single documented workflow shows an agent autonomously scaffolding a full pipeline (source+destination+sync) end-to-end via CLI/API; the AI Assistant that helps configure connectors lives in the no-code UI, not headless CLI/API, and connection/sync setup via API requires manual multi-step configuration. missing for 10: a documented single-command or agent-driven headless scaffold-to-run example, evidence of true end-to-end pipeline creation via API/CLI without UI steps, independent confirmation of agent-driven pipeline automation working in practice.
